sequence.cn: 上岸，本来是从水里走到岸上。
sequence.py: Shàng àn, běnlái shì cóng shuǐ lǐ zǒu dào àn shàng.
sequence.en: 上岸 originally just meant walking out of the water onto shore.

sequence.cn: 考试的人常常觉得自己在水里，心里只想着上岸。
sequence.py: Kǎoshì de rén chángcháng juéde zìjǐ zài shuǐ lǐ, xīnlǐ zhǐ xiǎngzhe shàng àn.
sequence.en: People preparing for exams often feel like they're stuck in water, thinking only about making it ashore.

sequence.cn: 所以现在被问“上岸了吗”，说的都是考试。
sequence.py: Suǒyǐ xiànzài bèi wèn “shàng àn le ma”, shuō de dōu shì kǎoshì.
sequence.en: So when someone asks you "上岸了吗" now, they're asking about your exam result.

sequence.cn: 我表弟考研考了两年，第一次差三分没上。
sequence.py: Wǒ biǎodì kǎo yán kǎo le liǎng nián, dì-yī cì chà sān fēn méi shàng.
sequence.en: My cousin studied for the grad-school exam for two years — the first attempt fell three points short.

sequence.cn: 第二年他还是一个人，在图书馆坐到闭馆，心里放不下那三分。
sequence.py: Dì-èr nián tā háishi yí ge rén, zài túshūguǎn zuò dào bìguǎn, xīnlǐ fàng bu xià nà sān fēn.
sequence.en: The second year, still alone, sitting in the library until it closed — those three points still stuck in his mind.

sequence.cn: 家里人都不敢问他，怕他一提就哭。
sequence.py: Jiā lǐ rén dōu bù gǎn wèn tā, pà tā yì tí jiù kū.
sequence.en: No one at home dared to ask — afraid that one word about it would set him crying.

sequence.cn: 昨天早上八点整，他打开了网页，手在抖。
sequence.py: Zuótiān zǎoshang bā diǎn zhěng, tā dǎkāi le wǎngyè, shǒu zài dǒu.
sequence.en: Eight sharp yesterday morning, he opened the results page — his hands were shaking.

sequence.cn: 页面刷新出来，录取两个字，他没喊也没哭。
sequence.py: Yèmiàn shuāxīn chūlái, lùqǔ liǎng ge zì, tā méi hǎn yě méi kū.
sequence.en: The page refreshed — two words: admitted. He didn't shout, didn't cry.

sequence.cn: 只是给妈妈打了个电话：妈，我上岸了。
sequence.py: Zhǐshì gěi māma dǎ le ge diànhuà: mā, wǒ shàng àn le.
sequence.en: He just called his mother: Mom, I made it to shore.
